Our technical approach is a repeatable, site-by-site delivery model that standardizes engineering, quality control, and documentation across all twelve hospitals while tailoring designs to each facility’s load profile, roof/ground conditions, and grid interconnection constraints. We will execute in controlled phases to maintain continuity of hospital operations, drawing on our completed solar deployments (including PKR 171M completed in 2024 and additional solar projects completed for provincial and federal government clients) [CAP-032][CAP-008][CAP-020], and our experience delivering at operational healthcare environments through hospital IT deployments for federal and provincial government clients [CAP-042][CAP-018].

Methodology (aligned to “design, supply, installation and commissioning”): (1) Site surveys & data capture: structural assessment, electrical single-line verification, transformer/feeder checks, shading analysis, and hospital access/HSE planning. (2) Detailed engineering: array/inverter sizing, stringing, protection and earthing, cable routing, SLDs, GA drawings, and method statements—ensuring all electrical works are executed to IEC 62548 and Pakistan Electricity Code through disciplined QA/QC and inspection test plans within our ISO 9001 quality management system [CAP-030]. (3) Procurement & logistics: Our library does not yet evidence Tier-1 module/inverter supply, minimum 21% module efficiency, or specific warranty terms; we will address this by proposing only OEM-authorized Tier-1 equipment with complete datasheets and warranties submitted for approval at submittal stage. (4) Installation, testing & commissioning: phased shutdown planning, insulation/continuity testing, functional tests, and as-built dossiers. (5) DISCO coordination & net-metering: Our library does not yet evidence DISCO net-metering liaison; we will mitigate by assigning a dedicated permitting lead and engaging an experienced local interconnection consultant during execution.

SCADA monitoring, three-year O&M, performance guarantees, and staff training will be delivered with commissioning handover packages; however, our library does not yet evidence prior SCADA-based solar monitoring or 3-year PV O&M guarantees, and we will close this via OEM monitoring platforms and specialist O&M partnering under our ISO 9001-controlled processes [CAP-030]. PMP-certified delivery is evidenced on prior engagements [CAP-005][CAP-027], and we will nominate a PMP-certified Project Manager compliant with the RFP at contract award.
